sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Expressions of Interest are invited from qualified professionals seeking appointment to the NABERS Embodied Carbon Independent Design Review panel. The panel supports the NABERS Commitment Agreement process, which enables new or refurbished buildings to commit to achieving a specific NABERS Embodied Carbon rating following construction.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Expressions of Interest are invited from qualified professionals seeking appointment to the NABERS Embodied Carbon Independent Design Review panel.

All Independent Design Reviews conducted by Independent Design Reviewers must:

1. Inform the designers and developers of a building as to its likely upfront embodied carbon and risks associated with their proposed building design and model.

In addition, Independent Design Reviews may be required to:

2. Demonstrate to NSW DCCEEW (NABERS) that a building is an appropriate candidate for a Commitment Agreement.

3. Demonstrate to a third party (such as a client or regulatory authority) that the proposed building can realistically be expected to achieve a given rating.
